NAAVIK GAMING PODCAST
Is Gaming a Mature Industry?
By Alexandra Takei   •   November 25, 2026
Is the gaming industry finally maturing, or entering a new era of growth and disruption? In this special episode recorded live in NYC at CCNY, our usual host
Alexandra Takei
, VP at Medal and General Intuition, finds herself on the other side of the mic in conversation with
Amir Satvat
, General Partner at 1UP, and
Alex Goldmark
, Executive Producer of Planet Money.
Together, they explore slowing industry growth, AI's impact on game development and employment, the growing challenge of discoverability, and whether blockbusters like GTA can still expand the market. Is gaming becoming a zero-sum industry, or will new technologies unlock its next growth cycle?
